full_logit_hash.scope: SHA-256 of every little-endian BF16 vocabulary value at scored positions, in window order

record_format.arithmetic: BF16 head logits; FP32 exp of (x - max), FP64 accumulation and log, FP32 outputs

state_policy: fresh zeroed ResidentState and cursor per window; no carry-over between windows or streams
